finding: research_policy.VOIPolicy is not a value-of-information computation. It is a hardcoded fixed preference order, ORDER=(REGULATORY_FILING, GOVERNMENT_DATA, INDEPENDENT_REPORTING, ANALYST_COVERAGE, COMPANY_OWNED), and its own docstring says it is 'here to be beaten'. Separately, evaluate_offline passes options=SOURCE_FAMILIES — all five families — for EVERY record, regardless of what was actually eligible for that decision.
implication: Because REGULATORY_FILING is first in ORDER and always present in the offered options, VOIPolicy is expected to be numerically identical to FixedPolicy(REGULATORY_FILING) on the current log. The reported 'VOI prefers filings' is therefore a property of a constant plus a fictitious choice set, not a miscalibrated heuristic. Falsifiable prediction to be measured under B-VOI-001.
action: B-VOI-001 retained as READY; B-POL-001 (choice-set-aware evaluation) recorded as a correctness fix rather than a feature

evidence: 34 tests green. Enforced invariants: a chosen action must appear in its own candidate set and be eligible there; a deterministic policy may not carry a propensity; SUCCESS with zero accepted evidence is refused; a failure must name its kind; an outcome may not start before its decision was written.
caveats: Decision granularity is per acquisition FAMILY per cycle, not per (family, subject), because that is what the cycle actually chooses. At ~3 families per night cycle and cadence gating, reaching the 100-decision gate takes on the order of 30+ cycles. Recorded in BLOCKERS.yaml rather than papered over by logging a decision per subject that nobody made.

evidence: On the 316-row reconstructed log VOI_HEURISTIC and FIXED_REGULATORY_FILING are identical on all six preregistered figures: matched 84, overlap 0.266, mean_reward 0.05, independent 1.0, duplicate 0.75, discriminating equal. The prediction was registered before measurement.
finding: VOIPolicy is a constant, not an estimate. Measured order by realized value is independent_reporting 0.7726 (dup 0.027) > analyst_coverage 0.7091 (dup 0.091) > regulatory_filing 0.0500 (dup 0.750) > company_owned -0.9344 (indep 0.0). The stated order asks regulatory_filing first.
cause: Of the candidates in the brief: NOT stale SourceFamilyPerformance (the policy reads no performance state at all), NOT duplication underpriced (duplicate is weighted -1.0 and is exactly why filing scores 0.05), NOT independence undervalued (independence is 1.0 for BOTH of the top two, so the order's stated rationale does not discriminate them). The separating variable is duplication, 0.75 vs 0.027.
not_done: The order was NOT flipped. A replacement derived from this log would be derived from evidence that survived, and the rows that would justify it are the actions that returned nothing. Duplication among retrieved documents is measurable here; hit rate per action is not.

evidence: ResearchRecord now carries eligible_options; evaluate_offline scores against the menu the row records and counts assumed_menu fallbacks.
decision: menu_is_real was deliberately NOT folded into `trustworthy`. Doing so marked every existing evaluation untrustworthy at a stroke (no reconstructed row carries a menu) and silently switched off the reward-hack audit that depends on it. Three pre-existing tests caught this. A cross-policy comparison stays meaningful under a shared assumed menu; a single policy's absolute value does not.

finding: The prospective sample is now rate-bound rather than capability-bound. The night cycle writes one decision per ELIGIBLE acquisition family; cadence gating left 2 of 3 eligible, so ~2 decisions accrue per night and the 100-decision gate is roughly 50 cycles away.
implication: B-POL-002, B-HACK-001 and B-VOI-002 became READY when A-RD-008 completed, but their minimum_data is unmet at 2/100. Set to BLOCKED_DATA so the frontier does not hand a successor a node it cannot finish. frontier.py ranks by dependencies only and does not read minimum_data — a known limitation, reconciled by hand here.
invalid_workaround: Logging a decision per (family, subject) would multiply the count by 26 overnight and every one of those rows would be a choice the cycle never made. It selects families, not subjects.

evidence: 19 tests. The wall raises rather than filtering. Admission is by OBSERVATION time, never occurrence: a contract signed on the 3rd and announced on the 11th is invisible to a replay of the 5th, and leak_surface counts exactly how many rows an occurrence-time filter would have admitted. Moving the wall forward is refused. Undated rows are excluded and counted, never admitted on the grounds of probably being old enough. Episode selection is a fixed cadence over a stated window and an AST-level guard asserts it reads no outcome field.
note: The AST guard replaced a substring search that failed on its own docstring — the recorded 'structural guards must read code, not prose' trap, hit and corrected within the same file.

evidence: 16 tests. Nine methods declared with question types, minimum samples, assumptions and failure modes; three implemented (persistence, drift, AR1). A declared-but-unimplemented method RAISES rather than falling back to a simpler one under its name. compare() scores every method on ONE training window, because a method needing less history would otherwise get more predictions and easier ones.

Walk-forward over 15 real macro series from the production ledger. Persistence best on 9, AR1 on 4, drift on 2. On the four LONG series (520 points each) persistence wins three and AR1 takes BOC_FXUSDCAD by 0.4%, which is inside noise. TREASURY_NOTES_AVG_RATE shows AR1 +0.586 and drift +0.469 skill, but it has 24 observations and an 8-point training window, so ~16 out-of-sample predictions.
finding: On this corpus nothing reliably beats persistence for short-horizon macro LEVELS. That is the expected and useful answer: it sets the bar every later method must clear, and it is the reason the registry scores against persistence rather than against other methods.
caveat: The 24-point results are reported as suggestive, not established. A method that wins on 16 predictions has not beaten anything. Recorded rather than promoted.

evidence: frontier.py evaluates data gates mechanically from METRICS.json, measured by metrics.py against the live ledger with measured_at attached. 15 tests including dependency-met-but-data-short, data-arrives-node-becomes-READY-without-a-manual-edit, data-invalidated-node-reverts, missing-metric-blocks, and a test asserting no task identifier appears in frontier.py.
decision: Derived state is no longer stored. READY / WAITING_DEPENDENCY / BLOCKED_DATA are computed and never written back; TASK_GRAPH keeps only what a measurement cannot establish, marked DERIVED. --check fails if a concrete derivable status reappears. This removes the drift class where TASK_GRAPH said READY while BLOCKERS said blocked — they were two copies of one fact.

finding: knowledge_step computed 343 attributions, summarised them into the report, and persisted none. The ledger held 6, all written by belief formation in learning_cycle.py — the only production call site of record_knowledge_effect.
implication: The effect log is the table the research reward is priced from, so every cross-cycle claim about what evidence CHANGED was made against a table that was empty in practice. Within a single cycle log_from_effects used the in-memory list and worked, which is why nothing surfaced it.
action: knowledge_step now persists, idempotent on effect_id; the report carries persisted, already_held and persistence_gap beside the computed count. A count of what was computed with no count of what was kept is the shape that hid it. This is the recorded 'learned is not saved' pattern.

evidence: 22/22 after repair. First run 19/22 with three real findings, each fixed in the code or the test rather than by repointing the proof.
findings: v4d-11 NOT_CAUGHT: the menu test asserted matched==0, which holds whether the policy is scored against the recorded menu or all five families, because VOI's first pick fails to match either way. Rewritten so the recorded menu makes VOI fall through and match everything. v4d-18 NOT_CAUGHT: the window test asserted only that every method got an EQUAL number of predictions, which min and max both satisfy; it now asserts the window is at least the largest declared minimum_sample, so AR1 cannot be scored on a history it says is too short. v4d-22 ALREADY_RED: no test for effect persistence existed at all — the proof pointed at a test in another file. Written, and it initially passed for the wrong reason because an empty ledger yields no subjects and therefore a trivially zero persistence gap; it now seeds an evidence row.

evidence: 19 tests, 4 break proofs (v4d-23..26). Append-only contiguous revision chain: a revision names the revision it follows and appending off-head is refused, so the chain cannot fork and lose a branch. what_changed_your_mind() answers from records — the reason string is the one written at the transition, never generated from the two claims.
guards: A transition other than CREATED must name a KnowledgeEffect id or triggering evidence; prose alone is refused. A STRENGTHENED transition must name an EFFECT specifically — a claim may only become more believed on evidence that changed something. An alternative may not disappear without evidence eliminating it. diff() compares fields as data, not prose.
caveat: Built and unit-proven; NOT yet wired into knowledge_step, so no live cycle has produced a revision. Maturity is IMPLEMENTED, not INSTRUMENTED. G-THE-001's dependents (H-CEO-001) are READY on the architecture, but a CEO answer sourced from an empty chain would say 'nothing has changed this thesis', which is true and useless. Wiring is the next node.

evidence: Mechanical check of every COMPLETE capability whose acceptance implies runtime use, by grepping production importers under src/. research_decision 1 (steps.py), thesis_history 1 (steps.py), runtime_provenance 1 (report.py), knowledge_effect 6, research_policy 2. vintage 0, economic_method 0, and ResearchDelayedOutcome has ZERO production callers.

evidence: 27 tests + 4 break proofs (v4d-27..30). knowledge_step now persists a thesis snapshot per cycle and reconciles it against the next cycle's theses; revisions and snapshots are new LearningStore record kinds; cycle1 snapshot / cycle2 revision / cycle3 identical-no-append proven, and a fresh store reads the history back.
decisions: Identity is (subject, question), not thesis_id, because thesis_id hashes the claim and date so a one-word change would read as a brand new thesis and lose the comparison. An effect evidences a thesis only when it names the thesis or one of its exposures or macro conditions — attaching every effect from the cycle to every thesis about the same company would make each revision look evidenced and mean nothing.
